name: Simple Soup
body: Dish - Extra; Taste 1.

name: Prep
body: Time; Gain 1 Time.

name: Practice Session
body: Time; Gain 2 Time.

name: Masterclass
body: Time; Gain 3 Time.

name: Cheese Board
body: Dish - Extra; Tags: Cheese; During judging if you present another Cheese dish gain +2 Favor and 1 Time.; Taste 2.

name: Raclette
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Cheese, Meat; Other Cheese dishes you present get +1 Taste.; Taste 4.

name: Foie Gras Toast
body: Dish - Appetizer; Tags: Meat; If this is your only Appetizer it gets +2 Taste.; Taste 5.

name: Bouillabaisse
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Seafood; During judging if this is your only Main it gets +2 Taste.; Taste 3.

name: Escargots
body: Dish - Appetizer; Tags: Seafood; If the Judge does not favor you this gets +2 Taste.; Taste 2.

name: Saucisson
body: Dish - Extra; Tags: Meat; You may attach this to another Dish. If you do, gain 1 Time.; Taste 1.

name: Burger
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Meat, Tomato; During judging if you present an Extra this gets +1 Taste.; Taste 2.

name: Hot Dog
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Meat; During judging if you present another Main this gets +2 Taste. If that Main is Meat, gain 1 Time.; Taste 2.

name: Fried Chicken
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Meat, Fried; During judging if you present another Fried dish this gets +2 Taste.; Taste 3.

name: Freedom Fries
body: Dish - Extra; Tags: Fried; During judging if you present a Meat dish this gets +2 Taste and you gain 1 Time.; Taste 1.

name: Deep-Fried Pickles
body: Dish - Appetizer; Tags: Fried; During judging if you present another Fried dish this gets +2 Taste and each opponent gains Food Coma.; Taste 1.

name: Sloppy Joe
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Meat, Tomato; During judging if you present another Tomato dish gain +1 Favor.; Taste 2.

name: Sushi Set
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Seafood, Rice; During judging if you present Appetizer Main and Dessert gain +2 Favor.; Taste 3.

name: Onigiri
body: Dish - Extra; Tags: Rice; Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Discard up to 1 of them. If it is a Status, Peel it instead.; Taste 1.

name: Tempura
body: Dish - Appetizer; Tags: Seafood, Fried; During judging if you present no duplicate core course this gets +1 Taste.; Taste 2.

name: Katsu Curry Rice
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Fried, Rice; If you Peeled this turn this gets +1 Taste.; Taste 3.

name: Sashimi
body: Dish - Appetizer; Tags: Seafood; Draw 2 then discard 1. If you discard a Status, gain 1 Time.; Taste 2.

name: Takoyaki
body: Dish - Extra; Tags: Seafood, Fried; If this is your only Extra, you may Peel 1. Then look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put 1 on the bottom of your deck.; Taste 2.

name: Margherita Pizza
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Cheese, Tomato; During judging if you present another Cheese or Tomato dish this gets +1 Taste.; Taste 2.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Tomato; If the Judge does not favor you this gets +2 Taste.; Taste 2.

name: Caprese
body: Dish - Appetizer; Tags: Cheese, Tomato; During judging if you present a Main gain +1 Favor.; Taste 2.

name: Risotto
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Cheese, Rice; During judging if you present another Rice or Cheese dish gain +1 Favor.; Taste 3.

name: Tiramisu
body: Dish - Dessert; If the Judge does not favor you gain +2 Favor.; Taste 2.

name: Arancini
body: Dish - Appetizer; Tags: Cheese, Rice; During judging if you present another Rice dish gain +1 Favor.; Taste 2.

name: Ghost Pepper Wings
body: Dish - Main; Tags: Meat, Fried; When you present this, Scorch 3.; Taste 6.

name: Wasabi Challenge
body: Dish - Appetizer; Tags: Seafood; When you present this, Scorch 2. If you Scorched a Status this way, gain 1 Favor.; Taste 4.

name: Side Salad
body: Dish - Flexible; When you present this, choose which course it counts as.; Taste 1.

name: Tasting Menu
body: Dish - Flexible; When you present this, choose which course it counts as. If it completes all 3 core courses, gain 1 Time.; Taste 2.

name: Knife Skills
body: Technique; Choose a starter card you played this turn. If it is Prep, gain 2 Time. If it is Simple Soup, it gets +2 Taste this turn.

name: Clean Station
body: Technique; Choose one - Peel up to 2 starter cards; or Peel Clean Station.

name: Taste Test
body: Technique; Draw 3 then discard 1. If the discarded card is a starter card or Status, you may Peel it.

name: Heckle
body: Technique; Each opponent gains a Distraction. If there is only one opponent, they gain 2 Distractions instead.

name: Perfect
body: Technique; Choose a Dish. Double its Taste this turn.

name: Mock
body: Reaction; Choose an opponent's highest-Taste presented dish. It gets -2 Taste this turn. Draw 1.

name: Drown in Butter
body: Reaction; Choose an opponent's presented dish. If it is not French it gets -3 Taste this turn and its owner gains Food Coma.

name: Mine Is Better
body: Reaction; Reveal a Dish from your hand. If it has more Taste than an opponent's presented dish that dish gets -3 Taste this turn.

name: Bon Appetit!
body: Technique; Draw 1. During judging if one of your dishes has 5 or more Taste gain +2 Favor.

name: Supersize Me!
body: Technique; During judging copy one of your dishes as an additional presented dish.

name: More Meat!
body: Technique; Tags: Meat; Your Meat dishes get +1 Taste this turn. During judging if you present at least 2 Meat dishes gain +2 Favor.

name: Deep Fry
body: Technique; Tags: Fried; Choose a Dish. It becomes Fried this turn and gets +2 Taste.

name: Party
body: Technique; Draw 1 and gain 1 Time. During judging if you present at least 3 dishes gain +2 Favor.

name: Ketchup Me That
body: Technique; Tags: Meat, Fried; Choose a Meat or Fried dish. It gets +2 Taste.

name: Appropriate
body: Reaction; Choose an opponent's presented dish. After that opponent scores, steal that dish and add it to your discard pile. Peel Appropriate.

name: Purify
body: Technique; Peel up to 2 cards. If you Peel a Status this way, draw 1.

name: Order
body: Technique; Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Omakase
body: Technique; Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Dish. Put it into your hand and discard the rest. You may present that Dish this turn. During judging if your meal completes all 3 core courses, gain +2 Favor.

name: Less Is More
body: Technique; During judging if you present exactly Appetizer Main and Dessert with no duplicate core course gain +5 Favor.

name: Wasabi Attack
body: Reaction; Seafood; Choose an opponent's dish. It gets -1 Taste. If it is not Seafood it gets -3 Taste instead. Its owner Scorches 1.

name: Mangia, Mangia!
body: Technique; Draw 1. If the Judge does not favor you, draw 2 and gain 1 Time instead.

name: Mamma Mia!
body: Technique; Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Dish. Put it into your hand and discard the rest, then draw 1. You may present that Dish this turn. If the Judge does not favor you, gain 1 Time.

name: Secondo
body: Technique; During judging score one Main a second time.

name: Breaking Spaghetti Is A Crime
body: Reaction; Each opponent who modified a dish this turn gains Shame. Choose one modified dish; it gets -2 Taste.

name: More Olive Oil!
body: Technique; Tags: Tomato, Cheese; Choose a Tomato or Cheese dish. It gets +2 Taste. If the Judge does not favor you, it gets +3 Taste instead.

name: More Parmigiano!
body: Technique; Tags: Cheese, Tomato; Choose a Main. It gets +2 Taste. If it is Cheese or Tomato it gets +3 Taste instead.

name: Market Research Focus Group
body: Technique; Rotate up to 3 cards in the market. Draw 1. Gain 1 Time.

name: Yelp Bomb
body: Reaction; Choose an opponent. They gain a Yelp Review. Draw 1.

name: Health Inspector Raid
body: Technique; Each opponent gains a Health Inspection. Rotate the whole market.

name: We're Gonna Build A Wall
body: Technique; Each opponent gains a Health Inspection. Until your next turn, opponents cannot steal your dishes. If any opponent has more Favor than you, gain 1 Time.

name: Freedom Isn't Free Refills
body: Technique; Gain 2 Time. Each opponent gains Food Coma. During judging if you present an Extra gain +1 Favor.

name: Mandatory Lunch Strike
body: Technique; Each opponent gains Strike. You may Peel a starter card.

name: You Call That Sushi?
body: Reaction; Each opponent Scorches 1. For each Status Scorched this way, draw 1.

name: Nonna Says No
body: Reaction; Cancel one Taste reduction or opponent modifier on one of your dishes. That opponent gains Shame.

name: Pineapple Tribunal
body: Technique; Tags: Tomato, Cheese; Each opponent who presented or modified a Tomato or Cheese dish this turn gains Shame. If any of those dishes is American, its owner also gains a Distraction.

name: Pantry Raid
body: Technique; Draw 3 then discard 2. If you discarded a Status, gain 1 Time.

name: Mise En Place
body: Technique; Look at the top 6 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your hand and discard the rest.

name: Doomscroll The Menu
body: Technique; Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put 2 into your hand and discard the rest. Gain a Distraction.

name: Chef's Kiss
body: Technique; Draw 2. Choose a Dish on your board; it gets +1 Taste this turn.

name: Super Bowl Commercial Break
body: Technique; Draw 2. Each opponent may draw 1; each who does gains Food Coma.

name: Bento Box Planning
body: Technique; Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put 1 into your hand. You may discard any Statuses among the rest. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Secret Family Recipe
body: Technique; Tags: Tomato, Cheese; Put a Dish from your discard pile into your hand. Draw 1. If it is Tomato or Cheese, gain 1 Time.

name: Midnight Snack
body: Technique; Play a card from your Fridge. If it is a Dish, it gets +2 Taste this turn. Draw 1.

name: Fridge Raid
body: Technique; Look at an opponent's Fridge. You may discard that card. If you do, that opponent gains Food Coma.

name: 5 Stars
body: Passive; During judging if one of your dishes has strictly more Taste than every opponent's dish gain +4 Favor.

name: Bottomless Refills
body: Passive; During judging if you present an Extra gain +2 Favor.

name: Conveyor Belt
body: Passive; At the start of your turn, before drawing, look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may discard any Statuses among them. Put any number of the rest on the bottom of your deck and the rest on top in any order.

name: Nonna's Table
body: Passive; The first time each turn you present 4 or more dishes gain +2 Favor. If the Judge does not favor you, gain +3 Favor instead.

name: Steakhouse
body: Passive; Tags: Meat; Your first Meat dish each turn gets +1 Taste. During judging if you present at least 2 Meat dishes gain +2 Favor.

name: Seafood Counter
body: Passive; Tags: Seafood; During judging if you present a Seafood dish gain +1 Favor and you may Peel 1.

name: Cheese Wheel
body: Passive; Tags: Cheese; Your Cheese dishes get +1 Taste.

name: Fry Station
body: Passive; Tags: Fried; During judging if you present a Fried dish gain +2 Favor.

name: Red Sauce Empire
body: Passive; Tags: Tomato; Your Tomato dishes get +1 Taste and cost 1 less to learn.

name: Rice Cooker
body: Passive; Tags: Rice; Rice dishes cost 1 less to learn. The first Rice dish you learn each turn goes on top of your deck even if it is not your first learned card.

name: Burger Diplomacy
body: Passive; Tags: Meat, Tomato; When you learn this, each opponent gains a Burger from the market deck or supply. Your Burgers get +2 Taste. Opponents' Burgers count as Statuses for your effects.

name: Bureaucratic Cheese Inspection
body: Passive; Tags: Cheese; Whenever an opponent presents a dish with 5 or more Taste, they gain a Yelp Review. Your tagless dishes cost 1 more Time to learn.

name: Conveyor Belt Shogunate
body: Passive; At the start of your turn each player Scorches 1. If the card you Scorch this way is a Dish, you may present it this turn.

name: Nonna's Witness Protection
body: Passive; The first time each turn an opponent gives you a Status, give that opponent Shame. Whenever an opponent gains Shame, gain 1 Favor.

name: Influencer Kitchen
body: Passive; Whenever you give a Status to an opponent, gain 1 Favor. At the start of your Fridge step, if you gave no Status this turn, gain a Distraction.

name: Review Bomb Campaign
body: Passive; Whenever you add a Status to an opponent's deck, put 1 token here. If there are 7 or more tokens here at judging, you win the game.

name: Meal Prep Subscription
body: Passive; The first time each turn you draw 2 or more cards from one effect, gain 1 Time. At the start of your Fridge step, if you have no cards in hand, draw 1.

name: Algorithmic Menu
body: Passive; At the start of your turn look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may discard 1. If you discard a Status this way, gain 1 Favor.

name: Meal Prep Containers
body: Passive; At the start of your turn, if your Fridge is full, gain 1 Time. The first Dish you play from your Fridge each turn gets +1 Taste.

name: FACTION - Appropriate
body: Faction; Whenever an opponent presents only dishes from one faction, after scoring steal their lowest-Taste presented dish and add it to your discard pile.

name: FACTION - Legislation
body: Faction; During judging, if your highest-Taste dish has strictly more Taste than each opponent's highest-Taste dish, gain 2 Favor and each opponent loses 1 Favor.

name: FACTION - Less Is More
body: Faction; Whenever an opponent draws 3 or more cards from one effect, that opponent Scorches 1.

name: FACTION - Without Cream!
body: Faction; At the start of your turn, if an opponent gained more Favor than you on their last turn, gain Favor equal to the difference, up to 3.

name: Foreigner Mistrust
body: Passive; At the start of your turn, each opponent gains a Judgment.

name: Wage Inequalities
body: Passive; Whenever you present a dish with 5 or more Taste, each opponent gains Strike.

name: Distraction
body: Status; No effect. It is still annoying.

name: Food Coma
body: Status; While this is in your hand, your first card learned each turn costs 1 more Time.

name: Yelp Review
body: Status; During judging your highest-Taste dish gets -1 Taste. Then Peel Yelp Review.

name: Health Inspection
body: Status; During judging if you present 3 or more dishes, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Health Inspection.

name: Strike
body: Status; The first Technique you play each turn costs 1 more Time. Then Peel Strike.

name: Shame
body: Status; During judging if you present dishes from 2 or more factions, lose 1 Favor. Then Peel Shame.

name: Judgment
body: Status; When drawn, reveal the top card of your deck. Peel it unless it is Japanese. Then Peel Judgment.

name: Mangia Mangia!
body: Status; When drawn, discard all Dish cards from your hand. Then Peel Mangia Mangia!.

name: On Strike
body: Status; When drawn, your Cook step ends. Then Peel On Strike.

name: We Heard You Have Oil
body: Status; When drawn, discard the highest-cost card from your hand. Then Peel We Heard You Have Oil.
